notes: YOK-77 first pass, awaiting the designer. Duels, elders and the boss run in the fight scene; YOK-96: merchant and dojo run in the rest-stop screen (scenes/ui/rest_stop.tscn), which needs no opponent (the 'opponent' and 'tier' there are now unused); a scene of its own for a type ('types') or for one node ('nodes', or the node's payload.scene in the map file) is an edit here. Stand-ins, both open questions: (1) [done by YOK-96] merchant and dojo used to be stand-in fights; (2) only the Kitsune has a kit, so every yokai not listed with a 'fighter' under 'opponents' fights as 'fallback_fighter' (logged). Giving the Oni its kit later = add an 'oni' entry with 'fighter': 'oni'. YOK-174: a yokai with no fighter still fights with its own move files (per kind; the fallback's where it has none; only its own specials) and its own behaviour profiles: 'plays_as' names that yokai when it is not the opponent's own id (elders name their yokai; the apprentice, which has neither, plays as the fallback Kitsune as before). Tiers are Y4's reaction delays; YOK-156: 'damage_dealt_pct' scales the damage the tier's opponent deals (Y4: the apprentice deals half, 50; left out = 100). Y4's per-tier damage-per-duel numbers are harness targets, not applied here. YOK-85, R8: 'coins' is what a won fight on the node pays (types: a duel 25, an elder 50); 'rows' replaces a type's amount on one row, so the row-8 elder pays no coins (its reward is the rare in its draft). The boss, merchant and dojo name none and pay 0.
